mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations to produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rose >0.5pp in one month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior quarter signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, HOUST declines do not produce negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month indicates robust manufacturing output, strengthening corporate profit expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases fail to produce positive SPX 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it indicates an exceptionally tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and real sales (RSAFS) signal deteriorating economic demand, reducing corporate revenue outlook and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and RSAFS fails to produce negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI growth exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.
